difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-N-faithful at source lines 4216-4221: for an abelian category the functor N from simplicial objects to chain complexes is faithful and reflects isomorphisms, injections and surjections. The proof at source lines 4223-4229 is two sentences: faithfulness is read off from the canonical splitting of the comparison map, and the reflection statements follow from the injective-map lemma for simplicial abelian objects. The card is terse but complete, with the two cited lemmas retained as context so the reduction is available inside the package.
